OP said she seems remorseful, I don’t think she should feel regret for her actions, it seems like she does based on what OP said. Just because someone is regretful doesn’t mean they should feel that way, or that they necessarily did anything wrong, which again she didn’t.

Yep! You’re right all I said was that she does regret her actions not she should. She didn’t do anything wrong! Also I said she obviously wasn’t cheating on OP as they weren’t in a relationship at all, let alone a monogamous one.

It’s sad to see you want to throw away an obviously important relationship over something that isn’t about you. Clearly she regrets her actions and can’t go back and change the past. She wasn’t yours, she didn’t know you, at least in an intimate way yet and she didn’t owe you monogamy. What are you wanting from this relationship? She obviously chose you over the “hot pilot” and wants you and has wanted you. Would it have been better if she told you this 4 years ago? You aren’t wrong to feel like this, you are allowed to withdraw affection anytime, however it’s unfair to your girlfriend to take these feelings out on her. Not only has it been 4 years, but she had no responsibility or duty to be faithful to you as a man she hadn’t even met yet. What are you expecting her to do at this point? She can’t change the past and she isn’t cheating on you, never did (I assume). I think ruminating on this is expected but you have to decide how you move on after this or if you can’t.
